task_name: INSPECT EXISTING PROJECT & FREEZE TRADITIONAL RAG BASELINE ARCHITECTURE
project: Nghiên cứu cơ chế điều phối thích ứng trong hệ thống Agentic RAG tích hợp Corrective RAG hỗ trợ tra cứu pháp luật lao động Việt Nam

reusable_modules.purpose: Load and model records from legal_dataset_v2.json, validate chunk typing, sanitize nulls for vector DB ingestion.
Validate dataset chunks integrity prior to indexing.
Provide deterministic token counting for context budgeting without external tokenizer dependencies.
Single Source of Truth frozen corpus for vector store indexing.

llm_specification.refusal_message: Căn cứ theo tài liệu pháp luật lao động được cung cấp, hiện chưa có đủ thông tin quy định cụ thể về vấn đề này.

primary_recommendation.suitability: Optimal for Vietnamese legal text up to 800 tokens, 1024 dimensions, state-of-the-art dense retrieval.

fallback_recommendation.suitability: Zero local VRAM footprint, high throughput.

vector_db_specification.metadata_handling: Sanitize null values to empty strings or omit keys to ensure ChromaDB compatibility.

linear_pipeline_steps: Dense Vector Retrieval (ChromaDB HNSW Cosine Search)
Top-K Chunks Selection (K=5, similarity threshold filter)
Context Builder (metadata headers, token budgeting max 3000 tokens)
LLM Generation (temperature=0.0, strict Vietnamese legal prompt)

implementation_milestones.name: SETUP DEPENDENCIES & ENVIRONMENT
implementation_milestones.description: Establish environment, create requirements-rag.txt, verify PyTorch CUDA on RTX 5060, install chromadb.

implementation_milestones.name: CONFIGURATION & SCHEMA IMPLEMENTATION
implementation_milestones.description: Implement rag/config.py and rag/schema.py, integrating with Data_Processing/models_v2.py.

implementation_milestones.name: EMBEDDING PROVIDER IMPLEMENTATION
implementation_milestones.description: Build EmbeddingProvider abstract interface, implement BAAI/bge-m3 (CUDA) and OpenAI fallback, write unit tests.

implementation_milestones.name: CHROMADB VECTOR STORE & INDEXING CLI
implementation_milestones.description: Implement ChromaVectorStore, create batch indexer rag/indexer.py, ingest 1,390 chunks of Dataset V2.1.

implementation_milestones.name: DENSE RETRIEVER IMPLEMENTATION
implementation_milestones.description: Implement DenseRetriever with Top-K and similarity threshold filtering, add retrieval unit tests.

implementation_milestones.name: CONTEXT BUILDER & TOKEN BUDGET MANAGER
implementation_milestones.description: Implement structured context builder, enforce 3,000 token budget, preserve legal article/clause headers.

implementation_milestones.name: LEGAL PROMPT ENGINEERING & LLM WRAPPER
implementation_milestones.description: Design Vietnamese legal system instructions and refusal logic, implement OpenAI and Gemini LLM providers.

implementation_milestones.name: CITATION FORMATTER & GROUNDING VALIDATOR
implementation_milestones.description: Implement legal citation parser, verify alignment with retrieved chunks, format source URLs.

implementation_milestones.name: END-TO-END TRADITIONAL RAG PIPELINE
implementation_milestones.description: Assemble TraditionalRAGPipeline orchestrating all components, write comprehensive E2E tests and CLI entry point.

implementation_milestones.name: BASELINE EVALUATION & FREEZING
implementation_milestones.description: Evaluate on benchmark query set (Hit@K, MRR, Faithfulness), produce baseline report and freeze metrics.
